definitions: Irrelevant or unimportant to the current discussion.
Not pertinent to the main point being made.
examples: Whether he likes the color or not, that is neither here, nor there; we need to focus on the functionality.
Her personal feelings about the project, that is neither here, nor there; we have a deadline to meet.
The cost of the coffee, that is neither here, nor there; the important thing is the quality of the meeting.
lemma: that is neither here, nor there
source: that is neither here, nor there
